preamble: Clean, quiet game-interface texture art for a fantasy grand-strategy game, painted but restrained: matte surfaces, very fine and low-contrast material texture visible only at close view, flat even diffuse light, every plate lit uniformly from edge to edge with no vignette, no gradient, no glare, no darker or lighter corners, no wear marks, no stains. The Chronicle: the illuminated record of the age. Smooth carved blue-grey slate (#2D353A) with a very fine even grain, an inlaid bronze line (#78664C, lit edge #CAB289) with small diamond studs at the corners, vellum leaves (#E2D1B5), rubric red cloth (#5C1714).
tail: No cast shadows outside the plates, no text, no letters, no numbers, no runes, no figures, no faces, no animal heads, no crosses, no sun discs, no skulls, no crowns, no modern objects. No signature or maker's mark. The corners and the bottom edge of the image hold only the plain black ground.
layoutNote: Every cell is one flat rectangular piece seen straight on, filling its own cell edge to edge as a full-bleed swatch, all cells the same size, separated by narrow black gutters. Any line or rim of a plate runs straight along its four sides at an even width; the body inside it is one plain, uniform surface with no motif.
